attempts.url: no vendor OpenAPI; the Gemini API publishes a Discovery document

notes: Full coverage of the Gemini API (generativelanguage v1beta), converted from the verbatim Google API Discovery document committed as upstream.json. The conversion is 1:1: every one of the 86 resource methods and all 226 Discovery schemas is modelled (92 operations, 226 components out) — models, generateContent/streamGenerateContent, embedContent, tunedModels, cachedContents, files, corpora, batches and dynamic retrieval. v1beta is the version Google publishes a Discovery doc for and the one the adaptor targets. The gemini adaptor calls this API through the Google SDK; the whole API is described here (not just prompt/deepResearch/generateImage) so a workflow can reach any endpoint. Replaces a 6.6 KiB hand-authored spec. Refreshed 2026-11-16 from Discovery revision 20261113 (was 20260901): one new method (environments.files.media.upload), 16 methods and 33 schemas changed, 5 schemas added. Since 2026-11-16 every method that accepts media also has its Discovery `mediaUpload` URIs as operations of their own (`<method id>.simpleUpload` at /upload/..., `<method id>.resumableUpload` at /resumable/upload/...), which the googleapis SDK really calls for uploads and which the earlier conversion dropped. That accounts for 6 of the 92 operations (three upload methods, two protocols each).
